d:
Short, frizzy ash-grey hair with wild tufts and a coarse texture. Squinting olive-green eyes with a mischievous expression. Apparent age of seventy with a wrinkled, aged maturity. Small, hunched build. Wears a tattered charcoal-grey shawl over a faded indigo linen dress. A crooked wooden staff held in a gnarled hand.
BODY COLOR: weathered skin
